[h2]☁️Cloud Saving is Coming to Prodigal!☁️[/h2]

On August 19th, Cloud Saving will be enabled on Prodigal.

Once it is enabled and if you have files on two different devices, make sure to first play on the device with the data you want to keep!

If you want to keep both sets of saves, you can manually store them by copying the PS.syr files from "Users\AppData\LocalLow\Colorgrave\Prodigal". The number in the file name corresponds to the save slot in the game's menu.

notes.title: Crocodile Run 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38833454/fa5e05c575931a13ce0ef975345994a89eb6fc3d.png[/img]

Come one come all! The rules and rewards for the next exciting Crocodile run are here!  There's a chance for something for everyone win or lose.  New to speedrunning?  Drop into our #prodigal-speedrun channel to meet the friendly and helpful folks who currently run the game, and learn the best tricks and routes!

Discord: https://discord.gg/BZUyytCet2

You can submit runs to the Speedrun.com category once the event has begun and your runs can be updated throughout the month, so even if your time gets beaten it's not over!

1st – 3rd place: 
Each top-3 participant will get to help us design and name an NPC that will appear in the upper floors of the Crocasino!*

One Small Favorite: 
You didn't win, but darn it you tried your best! We'll choose one of the participants who's run we enjoyed watching the most! Winners of this award will also get to help design an NPC!*

Wooden Spoon:
One Speedrunner of the non-winning participants will be chosen  at random to have their name appear somewhere in the game! An additional Wooden Spoons will be given away for every 10 participants.
*NPC design and dialogue may need to be adjusted at the team's discretion

Run submissions will be allowed between Sept 1st-30th CDT

To help new players get started in Speedrunning our current #1 in Any% made a video guide of the run that also gives general tips and tricks to help people get into running the game.

Siska has decided to grace us with her presence, just be careful! It seems she has a few plans up her sleeves.

Alongside her, Hugh has come out of his shell a bit more, and will probably need a friend... maybe you have what it takes? But you'll have to assist a certain hat-wearing lady first if you want to help him.

[h1]Gods and Gamblers[/h1]

[h3]Difficulty[/h3]
We heard you loud and clear, and have included a new way to increase the difficulty in your game! After you've beaten the game at least once, you'll meet a robed stranger who will lead you to a way to offend the Gods. And they will make you pay for it.

[h3]New Character[/h3]
A stranger has come to Vann's point on a mission, although she may find bunnies a bit more distracting. Make sure to check up on the sheriff's office during Act 2 in order to see how you can help.

[h3]Tara[/h3]
Tara has a new plan up her sleeve, one involving the rich and beautiful Ashwood. Make sure to also talk to her in Act 2 to see what she has in store.

[h3]New Minigames[/h3]
We've added two new minigames to the Crocasino! Clementine and Illy are here to make your life even better, and hey, at least they aren't rigged.

[h3]Crocodile[/h3]
Lastly, rumor has it, Crocodile has shown up in Vann's Point, and has allowed visitors inside his 'collection'. If you're lucky, he may even let you in his backroom - where treasure awaits!

We hope you enjoy this new update as much as we do, and can't wait to show you more in the future!

"This place makes me uneasy. . . I shouldn't be here." 

Maybe finding secrets is a good thing? 

Hmm... and how do I get into that house near Castle Vann without a key? There is a rumor of some haunted tunnels that run underneath the Castle, maybe I should check there?

And that Tess girl, didn't she want some kind of shipment from Esterosa? Maybe I should check the shipping port, I know packages always got lost in that big building. Maybe whatever is in there will help with her insomnia.
